items.title: Meta’s AI agent Muse lands on Apple Watch and Android Wear OS
items.summary: Users can now interact with Meta’s AI assistant through voice calls, text messages, or dictation on their Apple Watch.

items.title: Adobe brings AI agents and new creative tools to Photoshop, Premiere, and Firefly
items.summary: Adobe is taking on Figma with a new prototype builder tool in Firefly.

items.title: Anthropic sets IPO price range of $70 to $78 per share to reach an implied valuation of $1.404 trillion
items.summary: The company could end up being worth a hefty $1.404 trillion if its shares list at the top of the price range, on a fully diluted basis.

items.title: Spotify’s AI DJ gets new voices, personalities, and an option for less chatter
items.summary: Spotify Premium users can now customize their AI DJ with new voices with different personalities, or turn off the commentary between songs.

items.title: After challenging Google’s Android with Cyanogen, its co-founder takes aim at Windows for AI era
items.summary: Kora is set to launch as a free-to-use alternative to Windows, targeting users who rely heavily on AI models and agents.

items.title: Cyberattacks threaten to make open-source AI a little less open, Hugging Face exec warns
items.summary: Hugging Face executive Irene Solaiman warns that growing cyberattacks on open AI platforms could force tighter security restrictions, threatening the accessibility that makes open-source communities valuable to developers worldwide.

items.title: Otter AI can now follow conversations across 30+ languages
items.summary: Otter AI just added support for 27 languages and revealed an upcoming feature that can follow along if speakers switch between languages.

items.title: Anthropic reportedly plans to move forward with IPO plans
items.summary: The AI company is expected to set its valuation range this week, the Wall Street Journal reported.

items.title: Jensen Huang reportedly engaged a PR firm with a history of handling high-profile sex scandals a year ago
items.summary: The PR firm was enlisted shortly after an October 2025 New York Times report described Alice Huang's business dealings with Jensen Huang, Wired reported.

items.title: A short seller flagged Nvidia CEO’s ties to a suspected Chinese spy six months before the scandal
items.summary: Six months before Nvidia's spy scandal erupted, Culper Research was already questioning Jensen Huang's unusually close relationship with a Chinese executive.

items.title: The race is on to sue Nvidia
items.summary: Nvidia’s stock slid more than 4% after its board opened an investigation into Jensen Huang’s relationship with a suspected Chinese spy, and one securities law expert says the company’s earlier insistence that it was all “normal” could turn into a very expensive problem.

items.title: Jensen Huang pulls out of ElevenLabs Summit amid Nvidia controversy
items.summary: The Nvidia CEO also pulled out of an Anthropic event earlier.

items.title: Anthropic releases new Mythos and Fable models amid RSI concerns
items.summary: Anthropic says the new models "show improvements in areas like coding, reasoning, and vision," as well as in communicating more clearly with users.

items.title: Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy puts Nvidia’s China ambitions under scrutiny
items.summary: Jensen Huang’s alleged affair with a suspected Chinese spy threatens to complicate Nvidia’s lobbying efforts to loosen U.S. chip export restrictions and maintain access to China’s lucrative AI market.

items.title: Meta releases Muse Ember, a new lightweight model for agent execution
items.summary: At 10 cents per million input tokens, Ember is significantly cheaper than frontier competitors like Haiku and Luna.

items.title: Anthropic joins AI’s natural gas frenzy, buys $3.4B worth of turbines
items.summary: Anthropic bought billions of dollars' worth of natural gas turbines in a deal that could give it buyer's remorse.

items.title: Medium’s new TK app brings AI assistance directly into the writing process
items.summary: Medium's new writing app embraces AI-assisted writing, despite growing controversy over the technology's role in publishing.

items.title: Automattic debuts a platform to deploy vibe-coding apps amid a changing internet
items.summary: Automattic aims to compete with the likes of Lovable with Spacefast.

items.title: Is Jensen Huang’s job on the line? Yale’s Jeffrey Sonnenfeld estimates it’s ‘about a 50-50’
items.summary: Nvidia’s board is investigating Jensen Huang over his relationship with a suspected Chinese spy, and Yale’s Jeffrey Sonnenfeld thinks it’s roughly a coin flip whether Huang stays on as CEO.

items.title: Nvidia will investigate CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with possible Chinese spy
items.summary: In a memo to the company, Huang admitted that he had an affair.
